**基因组改变分数（FGA）**是 cBioPortal 对每个患者拷贝数负荷的汇总：|log2 比值|超过阈值的片段覆盖的基因组比例。按方向拆分即**获得分数（FGG）**与**丢失分数（FGL）**，参考文档将其与临床亚组做 ANOVA + Tukey 比较 \[1\]。本教程复现该算法（阈值 |log2R| > 0.2、按片段碱基加权）与参考的两种版式——堆叠与发散——于模拟分割表：

## 数据准备

60 个模拟患者各 8-26 个 CNV 片段（`sample, chr, start, end, value`，Xena genomicSegment 格式）。每个患者都有几个超过 ±0.2 阈值的亚克隆 CNV；III-IV 期患者更多更强——FGA/FGG/FGL 条形须还原该模式：

```{r load data}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(ggplot2); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(patchwork)})
set.seed(18001)
## 60 patients, CNV segments with planted subgroup burden
n_pat <- 60
clin <- data.frame(
  Patient = sprintf("P%02d", 1:n_pat),
  Gender  = factor(rep(c("Female", "Male"), each = n_pat / 2)),
  Stage   = factor(rep(c("Stage I-II", "Stage III-IV"), times = n_pat / 2)))
seg <- do.call(rbind, lapply(1:n_pat, function(i) {
  n_seg <- sample(18, 1)
  len <- sample(2e6, n_seg)
  start <- c(1, head(cumsum(len), -1))
  data.frame(sample = clin$Patient[i],
             chr = paste0("chr", sample(1:22, n_seg, TRUE)),
             start = start, end = start + len,
             value = rnorm(n_seg, 0, 0.12))
}))
## planted alterations: every patient gets a few subclonal CNVs, stage III-IV
## patients get many more strong ones
for (i in seq_len(n_pat)) {
  rows <- which(seg$sample == clin$Patient[i])
  n_alt <- 2 + if (clin$Stage[i] == "Stage III-IV") sample(4:8, 1) else 0
  sel <- sample(rows, min(n_alt, length(rows)))
  seg$value[sel] <- seg$value[sel] +
    sample(c(-1, 1), length(sel), TRUE) * runif(length(sel), 0.22, if (clin$Stage[i] == "Stage III-IV") 0.7 else 0.32)
}
## per-patient FGA/FGG/FGL (cBioPortal algorithm, |log2R| > 0.2)
fg <- do.call(rbind, lapply(clin$Patient, function(p) {
  s <- seg[seg$sample == p, ]; s$bases <- s$end - s$start
  tot <- sum(s$bases)
  data.frame(Patient = p,
             FGA = if (nrow(s)) sum(s$bases[abs(s$value) > 0.2]) / tot else 0,
             FGG = sum(s$bases[s$value > 0.2]) / tot,
             FGL = sum(s$bases[s$value < -0.2]) / tot)
}))
fg <- merge(fg, clin, by = "Patient")
```

## Visualization

### 堆叠与发散亚组条形

同一信息的两种视图：堆叠版汇总各亚组的 FGG + FGL（参考 Fig. 1 风格），发散版把获得（零下）与丢失（零上）分列并配 SE 误差线与逐指标 ANOVA 星号——植入的分期负荷在两图中都干净分离：

```{r}
#| label: fig-1.1FgaBars
#| fig-cap: "60 个模拟患者的 FGA/FGG/FGL 按临床分期：堆叠 FGG+FGL 百分比（上）与发散获得/丢失版式配 SE 与分期 ANOVA 星号（下）；cBioPortal 算法 |log2R| > 0.2。"
#| out.width: "85%"
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| fig-width: 7.5
#| fig-height: 6.5

summ <- fg %>% pivot_longer(c(FGA, FGG, FGL), names_to = "metric", values_to = "frac") %>%
  group_by(Stage, metric) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(frac), se = sd(frac) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop")
p_stars <- function(x) cut(x, c(-Inf, 0.0001, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, Inf),
                           labels = c("****", "***", "**", "*", "ns"))
## per-metric ANOVA across stage
star_tab <- fg %>% pivot_longer(c(FGA, FGG, FGL), names_to = "metric", values_to = "frac") %>%
  group_by(metric) %>% group_modify(~ {
    m <- aov(frac ~ Stage, data = .x)
    p <- summary(m)[[1]]$"Pr(>F)"[1]
    data.frame(p = p, star = p_stars(p))
  })
p1 <- ggplot(summ %>% filter(metric != "FGA"),
             aes(Stage, mean * 100, fill = metric)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack", width = 0.35, colour = "grey25", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(FGG = "#db5049", FGL = "#2082be"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Percent Genome Altered", title = "FGG + FGL by clinical stage (simulated)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) + theme(legend.position = "top")
p2 <- ggplot(summ %>% filter(metric != "FGA") %>%
               mutate(y = ifelse(metric == "FGG", -mean, mean),
                      se2 = ifelse(metric == "FGG", -se, se)),
             aes(Stage, y * 100, fill = metric)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.35, colour = "grey25", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = (y - se2) * 100, ymax = (y + se2) * 100), width = 0.12, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(data = star_tab %>% mutate(x = 1.5,
               ypos = ifelse(metric == "FGG",
                             -max(summ$mean[summ$metric == "FGG"] + summ$se[summ$metric == "FGG"]),
                             max(summ$mean[summ$metric == "FGL"] + summ$se[summ$metric == "FGL"]))) %>%
               mutate(ypos = ypos * 115),
            aes(x = x, y = ypos, label = star), inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey40") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(FGG = "#f17d80", FGL = "#79BEDB"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Percent genome gained (-) / lost (+)",
       title = "Diverging FGG/FGL with SE and stage ANOVA") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) + theme(legend.position = "top")
p1 / p2```


## 应用场景

::: {#fig-FgaApplications1}
![](../images/FgaPlot_demo.png){fig-alt="拷贝数负荷按亚组" fig-align="center" width="60%"}

拷贝数负荷按亚组
:::

任何逐样本负荷汇总都可复用此版式：突变 Mb 负荷、启动子高甲基化 CpG 比例、或 LOH 基因组比例。
